local_storage_info: 使用localStorage代替cookie来记住用户是否已经登录，他们在哪个板上等。 [[ localStorage is used instead of cookies to remember whether a user is already logged in, what board they were on, etc.
speech_synthesis_info: 大多数现代的Web浏览器都实现了语音合成引擎，该引擎可用于将文本转换为语音。 [[ Most modern web browsers implement a Speech Synthesis engine that can be used to turn text into speech.

speech_synthesis_info2: 如果您的设备支持语音合成，则默认情况下应安装一个或多个语音。有时，声音可能会“丢失”并停止出现在设备上。 [[ If your device supports Speech Synthesis, it should have one or more voices installed by default. Sometimes voices can get "lost" and stop appearing on the device.
file_uploads_info: 并非所有浏览器都支持%app_name%使用的现代文件上传功能。如果您的设备不支持，那么大多数现代桌面浏览器都应该可以上传。 [[ Not all browsers support the modern file uploading features that %app_name% uses. If your device doesn't, most modern desktop browsers should upload just fine.
file_storage_info: 设备和某些浏览器允许您存储文件以供离线使用。如果此功能不可用，则可以将某些文件存储在数据库中，但是您可能会遇到存储错误。 [[ Devices and some browsers allow you to store files for offline use. If this feature is not available, some files can be stored in the database but you may run into storage errors.
indexed_db_info: IndexedDB是用于下载电路板和电路板内容的存储工具，因此即使没有Internet连接，%app_name%仍然可以工作。如果设备的内存已满，有时这些数据库将被自动（并且意外地）删除。 [[ IndexedDB is a storage tool used to download boards and board contents so that %app_name% can still work even without an Internet connection. If the device's memory gets full sometimes these databases will be automatically (and unexpectedly) deleted.
sqlite_info: SQLite是另一个用于下载电路板和电路板内容的存储工具，因此即使没有Internet连接，%app_name%仍然可以工作。 SQLite数据库在许多设备上不可用，但未经许可不会被删除。 [[ SQLite is another storage tool used to download boards and board contents so that %app_name% can still work even without an Internet connection. SQLite databases aren't available on as many devices, but won't get deleted without permission.
media_recording_info: 媒体录制允许您使用设备的网络摄像头拍照和录制音频。某些移动设备使用自己的内置媒体录制工具，而不是%app_name%的录制器。 [[ Media Recording allows you to take pictures and record audio using your device's webcam. Some mobile devices use their own built-in media recording tools instead of %app_name%'s recorders.
xhr_cors_info: 为了脱机工作，%app_name%需要从多个网站下载图像。 XHR / CORS不需要此功能，但是它使下载过程更有效。 [[ In order to work offline, %app_name% needs to download images from multiple web sites. XHR/CORS is not required for this to work, but it makes the download process more efficient.
canvas_info: %app_name%使您可以对图像进行裁剪和着色以更好地满足您的电路板要求，并且使用称为Canvas的元素来实现此目的。 [[ %app_name% lets you crop and colorize images to better match your board requirements, and it uses something called the Canvas element to make that happen.
audio_playback_info: 如果您录制自己的声音，则希望能够播放它们，但并非所有浏览器都支持音频播放，或者并非总是支持%app_name%使用的文件类型。 [[ If you record your own sounds you'll want to be able to play them back, but not all browsers support audio playback, or don't always support the file types %app_name% uses.
drag_and_drop_info: 在移动设备上没有意义，但是在桌面浏览器上，在编辑时将图像和声音拖放到按钮上可以节省大量时间。 [[ It doesn't make sense on a mobile device, but on a desktop browser dragging and dropping images and sounds onto buttons while editing can save a lot of time.
file_reader_info: 如果您要从计算机上传图像或音频以在%app_name%中使用，则FileReader工具是必需的组件。 [[ The FileReader tool is a required component if you're uploading images or audio from your computer to use in %app_name%.
geolocation_info: %app_name%可以选择使用地理位置来跟踪使用情况并生成可以比较多个位置之间的通信的报告。 [[ %app_name% optionally uses geolocation to track usage and build reports that can compare communication across multiple locations.

inflections_tool_explainer: %app_name%是一个开源工具，支持多种语言和交互。当我们建立语言单词列表时，可以使用该词库检查工具从多个来源收集信息。在字形上掌握准确的信息有助于我们更好地支持社区。 请记住，此工具收集的所有信息将免费在线发布，并带有开放许可，供他人使用和受益。 [[ %app_name% is an open source tool that supports multiple languages and interactions. inflections_tips: 提示：有些单词有多种类型。有些替代类型太晦涩，以至于它们根本不值得包含在内，请考虑一下普通讲话者会说些什么。如果单词变形，请确保在第一个框中输入其词根（“ look”）。某些动词/副词的某些变形没有意义，请在方框中输入“ N / A”。对于对立面，只要有最明显的地方就行。如果您不确定某个单词，请不要害怕跳过它！ [[ TIPS: Some words have multiple types. Some alternate types are so obscure that they're not really worth including, think about what an average speaker might say. If the word is alreeady inflected ("looking") make sure to enter its root ("look") in the first box. Some inflections for certain verbs/adverbs don't make sense, please put "N/A" in the box. For opposites, just do the most obvious if any. If you're unsure about a word, don't be afraid to skip it!

usage_4: 有些人担心使用AAC的沟通者永远不会自己说话。但是，最近的研究表明，许多AAC用户一旦感到舒适或熟练后便会继续进行声音交流。 [[ Some people worry that communicators who use AAC will never speak on their own. However, recent research has shown that many AAC users move on to vocal communication once they are more comfortable or proficient.

home_boards_1: 每个人都是独一无二的，因此每个沟通者的词汇集通常也对他们来说是独一无二的。使用%app_name%，您可以选择入门套件（或构建自己的入门套件），并一遍又一遍地对其进行个性化设置。 [[ Everyone is unique, so often each communicator's vocabulary set will be unique to them too. home_boards_2: 重要的是要牢记最终目标。如果沟通者似乎能够成长为一个庞大的词汇表，而不是从少量的按钮开始并随时间增加更多，则从大量的按钮开始并隐藏一些按钮开始。 [[ The important thing is to plan with the end in mind. board_2: 建模是语言学习的好工具。研究表明，具有AAC模型的AAC用户在采用AAC和进行交流方面取得了更大的成功。 [[ Modeling is a great tool to language learning. Research has shown that AAC users who have people modeling for them have better success adopting and communicating using AAC.
board_3: 建模很简单！与通讯员交谈时，您要做的就是在屏幕上按下按钮。向他们展示如何使用可用的按钮来表达自己。不仅要模拟请求，还要模拟各种不同的思想，观念，观察和问题！您建模的次数越多，就可以向传播者提供更多示例，以了解您认为有效使用其设备的方式。 [[ Modeling is easy! All you do is hit buttons on the screen as you talk to the communicator. Show them how they can use the buttons they have available to express themselves. Don't just model requests, model all kinds of different thoughts, ideas, observations, and questions! The more you model, the more examples you'ree giving the communicator for what you consider valid ways of using their device.

a_little_about_core: 关于核心的一点 [[ A Little About Core
core_1: AAC的一个重要概念是“核心”一词。核心词是我们在日常交流中经常使用的词，可以有多种含义。核心词可以帮助成长中的沟通者全天学习交流，而不仅仅是在一两种情况下。 [[ One important concept with AAC is "core" words. Core words are words we use often in everyday communication, and can have multiple meanings. Core words can help growing communicators learn to communicate throughout their day, instead of just in one or two situations.
core_2: 想象一下，如果您能说的只是预定义的短语，例如“我饿了”，“我累了”或“让我们再做一次”。您将如何询问某人的日子？你怎么说你不喜欢什么？我们可以尝试教他们使用核心词构建自己的短语，而不是尝试思考传播者可能需要的所有可能的短语。 [[ Imagine if all you could say were predefined phrases like "I'm hungry", "I'm tired", or "Let's do that again." How would you ask someone about their day? How would you say you didn't like something? Instead of trying to think of all possible phrases a communicator might need, we can teach them to build their own phrases using core words.
core_3: 记住要牢记最终目标，并找到包含足够核心单词的词汇集，以使沟通者能够成长。 [[ Remember to plan with the end in mind, and find a vocabulary set with enough core words for the communicator to grow into.

home_return_1: 当选择按钮%app_name%会自动返回到主电路板。这有助于为每个按钮制定一致的顺序（称为运动计划），因此我们建议将其作为默认按钮，但可以根据需要进行更改。 [[ When a button is selected %app_name% will automatically return to the home board. This helps develop a consistent sequence for each button (called a motor plan), so we recommend it as the default but you can change it if needed.

touch_access: 触摸访问%app_name% [[ touch access to %app_name%
touch_1: 对于%app_name%中的通讯板，触摸或单击按钮是最常见的访问方法。通过点击或单击按钮，通讯员可以在各板之间导航并选择单词或短语，以使系统为它们说话。 [[ Touching or clicking buttons is the most common access method for communication boards like those in %app_name%. By tapping or clicking on buttons, communicators can navigate between boards and select words or phrases to have the system speak for them.
touch_2: 一些沟通者需要更多的便利，例如根据手指的抬起位置，更大的文本或按钮之间的较大间距进行选择。这些都是可以从%app_name%内部的“首选项”视图中配置的。 [[ Some communicators need additional accommodations, like selecting based on where they lift their finger, bigger text, or larger gaps between buttons. These are all configurable from a user's "Preferences" view inside of %app_name%.
scanning_access: 扫描%app_name%中的访问权限 [[ scanning access in %app_name%
scanning_1: 一些通信器存在电机控制问题，这使他们很难按屏幕上的小按钮。如果它们可以击中较大的目标，例如蓝牙或称为“ Switch”的已连接按钮，或者甚至击中屏幕，那么%app_name%可以将电路板分成越来越小的块，一次“扫描”它们，然后等待供用户使用其开关进行选择。 [[ Some communicators have motor control issues which make it hard for them to hit small buttons on a screen. If they can hit larger targets like a bluetooth or connected button called a "Switch", or even just hit the screen, then %app_name% can break the board up into smaller and smaller chunks, "scan" through them one at a time, and wait for the user to select using their switch.
scanning_2: %app_name%可以按行，列或自定义区域进行扫描，甚至可以使用其他声音或音量进行扫描，以使通信者不至于感到困惑。它可以与外部开关配合使用，也可以使屏幕成为一个巨型按钮或两个独立按钮。所有这些设置在用户的“首选项”视图中可用。 [[ %app_name% can scan by row, column, or custom region, and can even use a different voice or volume for scanning to make things less confusing for the communicator. It works with external switches, or you can make the screen a giant button, or two independent buttons. All of these settings are available in a user's "Preferences" view.
dwell_access: %app_name%中的驻留访问 [[ dwell access in %app_name%
dwell_1: 对于没有一致的电机控制的通信器，眼动仪有时可能是一种有效的访问方法。眼动仪是跟踪眼球运动的特殊相机。当通信者的注视停留在按钮上一段时间后，系统可以代表通信者选择该按钮。或者，某些系统可以使用摄像头或传感器跟踪听觉或身体运动，以将鼠标光标像操纵杆一样对待，并且当光标“停留”在按钮上时，将其选中。眼动或驻留跟踪的速度可能比交换机访问速度快，但更难于正确校准。 [[ For communicators without consistent motor control, eye trackers can sometimes be an effective access method. An eye tracker is a special camera that tracks eye movements. When a communicator's gaze lingers on a button for a period of time, the system can select that button on behalf of the communicator. Alternatively, some systems can track hear or body movement using cameras or sensors to treat the mouse cursor like a joystick, and when the cursor "dwells" over a button, it is selected. Eye or dwell tracking can be faster than switch access, but is more difficult to calibrate correctly.
dwell_2: %app_name%可以与任何支持光标控制的眼动仪或系统配合使用（我们已经测试了Tobii，MyGaze，eyetech和LC Technologies以及EagleEyes硬件）。因为％app_name％自行处理这些事件，所以只需禁用它们即可。您可以在用户的“首选项”视图上微调跟踪设置。某些系统，例如EyeTribe和EyeX，也将需要在“首选项”中进行其他配置。 [[ %app_name% can work with any eye tracker or system that supports cursor control (we have tested Tobii, MyGaze, eyetech and LC Technologies, and EagleEyes hardware). Just disable "click" events since %app_name% handles these on its own. You can fine-tune the tracking settings on the user's "Preferences" view. Some systems, like EyeTribe and EyeX, will require additional configuration in "Preferences" as well.
modeling_1: 当某人在学习交流时（无论是通过口语还是使用AAC），重要的是他们要有很多支持交流者，以帮助他们看到好的榜样并正确学习。 [[ When someone is learning to communicate (whether by speaking or using AAC), it's important that they have lots of supporting communicators helping them see good examples and learn correctly.
modeling_2: 在AAC世界中，很多人称其为“建模”，重要的是AAC用户周围的人们向他们展示如何有效使用其设备的示例（“您想要Cookie吗？让我向您展示，您可以说*想要*和然后* cookie *“）。 [[ In the AAC world many people call this "modeling", and it's important that people around AAC users are showing them examples of how to effectively use their device ("You want a cookie? Let me show you, you could say *want* and then *cookie*").
modeling_3: 如果在%app_name%中点按了清除按钮三下，您会看到一个手指图标，指示“建模模式”。在建模模式下，％app_name％会跟踪作为建模操作按下的按钮，这样它们就不会出现在传播者的使用情况报告中。再次点击“清除”以退出建模模式。 [[ In %app_name% if you triple-tap the clear button, you'll see a finger icon indicating "Modeling Mode". When in Modeling Mode %app_name% tracks buttons pressed as modeling actions so they don't show up in a communicator's usage reports. Tap "Clear" again to leave Modeling Mode.

extra_reports_1: 主管还可以查看用户的通信历史记录。出于隐私原因，默认情况下禁用日志和报告，但是如果启用它们，则用户的主管可以查看其通信随时间的进展情况。 [[ Supervisors can also review a user's communication history. For privacy reasons logs and reports are disabled by default, but if you enable them then the user's supervisors can see how their communication is progressing over time.
extra_reports_2: 报告包括诸如沟通者最常使用的单词，一天中的什么时间使用设备以及屏幕上的哪个位置等信息。这些信息可以帮助团队保持协调一致并按时完成任务。 [[ Reports include information like what words the communicator is using most often, what time of day the device is being used, and even where on the screen they're hitting. This information can help the team stay coordinated and on task.
extra_home_boards_1: %app_name%有许多不同的主机板，您可以立即使用它们，也可以在复制时进行个性化设置。有些主板有一些大按钮，有些则有许多小按钮。 [[ %app_name% has a number of different home boards that you can start using right away, or copy and personalize as you go. Some boards have a few large buttons, and some have many small buttons.
extra_home_boards_2: 更多的按钮意味着更多的表达方式，但是一些用户在他们可以可靠按下的按钮上受到限制（请记住，现在您始终可以隐藏按钮，稍后再添加，因此看起来“太忙”的面板可能实际上是随着时间的推移它们可以成长为某种东西）。 [[ More buttons means more options for expression, but some users are limited in how small a button they can reliably hit (keep in mind you can always hide buttons for now that you want to add later, so a board that looks "too busy" may actually be something they can grow into over time).

goals_explainer1: 目标是一种帮助沟通者及其支持团队保持其当前策略首要思想的方法。它们可以像“记住要使用核心词！”这样一般。或类似“输入新设置时使用问候语”之类的内容。请记住，这些可能是沟通者的目标（“回答是或否的问题”），或者是沟通者周围的支持团队的目标（“使用提示层次结构”）。 [[ Goals are a way to help the communicator and their support team keep their current strategies top of mind. They can be general like "Remember to use core words!" or specific like "Use greetings when entering a new setting". Remember, these can be goals for the communicator ("Answer questions with yes or no"), or for the support team around the communicator ("Use a prompting hierarchy").
goals_explainer2: 可以使用评估或在用户的日志上进行记录时，跟踪每个沟通者的目标。然后使用这些状态更新来显示有关目标如何随着时间推移进行的一般报告。 [[ Goals can be tracked for each communicator using assessments, or when making notes on a user's logs. These status updates are then used to show a general report of how the goal is progessing over time.
goals_explainer_3: 通过为沟通者创建目标，您可以随时开始使用目标。然后使用注释和评估来跟踪随着时间的推移实现目标的进度。用户可以有多个目标，但一次只能有一个“主要”目标。 [[ You can start using goals at any time by creating a goal for a communicator. want_to_fix_that: -自己没有错。许多人需要技术的帮助才能听到自己的声音。不幸的是，很多技术难以使用，难以配置并且非常昂贵。 %app_name%是尝试修复该问题的新AAC应用。 [[ -- through no fault of their own. Many people need the assistance of technology in order for their voices to be heard. Unfortunately, a lot of that technology is hard to use, is hard to configure, and is crazy expensive. %app_name% is a new AAC app that tries to fix that.
why_lingolinq: 为什么选择”%app_name%”？LingoLinq这个名字源于将语言与最需要它的人连接起来。我们相信每个人都值得拥有一个声音——一个易于使用、负担得起、自然到没有人会多想的声音。我们希望为日常使用的复杂沟通需求提供平易近人、简单的解决方案。 [[ Why ”%app_name%”? The name LingoLinq comes from linking language to the people who need it most. We believe everyone deserves a voice -- one that's easy to use, affordable to access, and so natural that nobody thinks twice about it. We want to provide approachable, simple solutions to complex communication needs that work for everyday use.
the_challenge_text: Some people need help being heard -- and the tools out there? Often clunky, confusing, and way too expensive.
our_mission_text: LingoLinq means linking language to the people who need it most. Everyone deserves a voice that's easy to use, affordable, and just works.
our_mission_closer: That's what LingoLinq is all about.
landing_cta_subtitle_intro: Start with our free tier. No credit card, no hardware, no commitment.
learn_as_you_go: 随手学习 [[ Learn as You Go
learn_as_you_go_content_1: 如果您不熟悉增强通信领域，那么它的几乎每个部分都会让人感到恐惧。您怎么可能知道正确的词和符号来满足个人的个人需求（以及想要，希望和希望）。不用担心，我们与许多不同的专家一起提供经过精心研究的模板，这些模板将帮助您入门。同样重要的是，我们为父母，照料者，兄弟姐妹提供了培训资源……参与支持个人的每个人都应该知道发生了什么事以及他们如何才能真正帮助成功地实现沟通策略。 [[ If you're new to the world of augmentative communication, just about every part of it feels intimidating. How could you possibly know the right words and symbols to pick for an individual's personal needs (and wants, and hopes, and wishes). Not to worry, we work with many different specialists to provide well-researched templates that will get you started. And just as importantly, we provide training resources for parents, caregivers, siblings... everyone involved in supporting an individual deserves to know what's going on and how exactly they can help the communication strategies be successful.
offline_content_1: 收集数据和跨设备工作非常好，但是仍然有很多地方没有良好的Wi-Fi连接。 %app_name%存储用户的板并在每个设备上登录，以便用户可以无中断地进行脱机通信。下次有互联网连接时，所有内容都会同步备份。 [[ Gathering data and working across devices is great, but there are still plenty of places where you won't have a good Wi-fi connection. %app_name% stores a user's boards and logs on each device so the user can communicate offline with no interrupts. Everything syncs back up the next time there is an internet connection.
personalization: 个性化和同步 [[ Personalization and Sync
personalization_content_1: 绑定到单个设备是有风险的，尤其是当您添加了许多自己的图片或四处移动图片符号以供个人使用时。您不仅可能会丢失数据和配置，而且如果屏幕破裂或电池没电了，您将很不幸，直到可以更换它为止。 %app_name%可在多个设备上工作，并为您保持内容同步，因此您不必担心。 [[ Being tied to a single device is risky, especially when you've added lots of your own pictures or moved picture symbols around for personal use. Not only can you possibly lose your data and configuration, but if a screen cracks or a battery dies, you're out of luck until it can be replaced. %app_name% works across multiple devices and keeps content in sync for you so you don't have to worry.
create_share: 创建，共享和重用 [[ Create, Share and Reuse
create_share_content_1: 创建一组通讯板时，没有人希望从头开始。 %app_name%使您可以轻松发现和个性化其他人创建的通信板。而且％app_name％鼓励内容和符号的开放许可，因此您不必怀疑是否在偶然的地方破坏了版权。 [[ Nobody wants to start from scratch when creating a set of communication boards. %app_name% lets you easily discover and personalize communication boards created by others. And %app_name% encourages open licenses of content and symbols, so you don't have to wonder if you're breaking copyright somewhere on accident.
open_board_support: %app_name%致力于使电路板开放和可重复使用。如此之多，以至于我们开始了 OpenBoards计划，以朝着标准文件格式迈进，以便跨所有应用程序和设备导入和导出木板，我们使用该格式作为我们的本机导入/导出格式。当我们有自由建立彼此的思想和成功的基础，而不管它们来自何处时，每个人都会获胜。 [[ %app_name% is committed to making boards open and reusable. So much so that we started the OpenBoards initiative to work toward a standard file format for importing and exporting boards across all apps and devices, and we use that format as our native import/export format. When we have the freedom to build off of each other's ideas and successes regardless of where they came from, everyone wins.
coordination_content_1: 必须将个人的通信设备从他们身边拿下来才能对其进行编程是一件可怕的事情，它剥夺了他们的声音。 %app_name%使治疗师，专家，父母和其他团队成员可以修改通讯集，甚至可以在每个人都可以从中受益的地方记录会话笔记和消息。 [[ Having to take an individual's communication device away from them in order to program it is a terrible thing, it takes away their voice. %app_name% lets therapists, specialists, parents and other team members modify the communication set and even log session notes and messages in a place where everyone can benefit from them.
insights_content_1: 有时很难知道什么在起作用，什么在不起作用。增强交流是一个不断进行的修改和引入词汇的过程，如果没有好的报告，就很难确定需要更改的内容。 %app_name%可以记录所有通信并根据时间，位置和词汇提供有洞察力的报告，从而使每个人都可以清楚地知道将精力集中在什么地方以获得最佳结果。 [[ Sometimes it's really hard to know what's working and what's not. Augmentative communication is an ongoing process of modifying and introducing vocabulary, and without good reports it's difficult to be sure what needs to change. %app_name% can log all communications and provide insightful reports based on time, location and vocabulary that makes it clearer for everyone just where to focus their efforts for the best results.
learn_as_you_go_catchphrase: Expert-designed templates and training so you never start from scratch.
work_offline_catchphrase: Communicate anywhere -- boards and logs sync when you reconnect.
personalization_catchphrase: Your setup follows you across every device, always up to date.
create_share_catchphrase: Discover boards, share openly, and build on each other's work.
coordination_catchphrase: Therapists and families collaborate without taking the device away.
insights_catchphrase: Clear reports that show what's working and where to focus next.
trust_transparency_text: We're talking about someone's voice -- potentially everything they ever say. That's deeply personal, and we treat it that way. Your data is encrypted, never shared without permission, and always yours to export.
security_content_1: %app_name%提供所有板，日志和用户信息的安全通信和存储。未经明确许可，我们不会共享用户数据，私人委员会和使用日志等私人信息。我们非常重视用户隐私，因为最终，我们正在谈论的是潜在地记录个人所说的一切。这类信息值得保护。 [[ %app_name% provides secure communication and storage of all boards, logs and user information. We do not share private information like user data, private boards and usage logs without explicit permission. We take user privacy extremely seriously because, at the end of the day, what we're talking about is potentially recording everything an individual ever says. That kind of information deserves to be protected.
open_source_content_1: 大多数AAC系统都是基于专有技术构建的，这意味着您并不真正知道它们的安全性，因此更容易被锁定并被迫进入其工作方式。 %app_name%是开放源代码，并且以开放的思维方式构建，因此您可以亲自了解系统中的内容，而且您始终可以轻松访问和导出所有数据。 [[ Most AAC systems are built on proprietary technology, which means you don't really know how secure they are, it's easier to get locked in and forced into their way of doing things. %app_name% is open source and built with an open mindset, so you can see for yourself what goes into the system, and you always have easy access and exports for all your data.

灿烂！接下来，让我们找出按钮的最佳尺寸！如果按钮太大，则将没有空间随着时间的推移而增长-尝试找到通信器可以可靠使用的最小尺寸。

robust_1: 刚开始时，健壮的词汇似乎有些令人生畏，但它们可以是功能强大的语言集，传播者可以随着时间的流逝而逐渐成长。尝试更多地关注通信器可以成功访问的按钮数量，而不是屏幕有多忙，因为您始终可以隐藏按钮并计划以后再启用它们。这些板卡可以强调运动计划或务实交流，但都具有核心词和专业词的良好集合，并且还提供个性化词汇的空间。 [[ Robust vocabularies may seem a little intimidating at first, but they can be powerful language sets that the communicator can grow into over time. Try to focus more on how many buttons the communicator can successfully access rather than how busy the screen is, because you can always hide buttons and plan to re-enable them later. These board sets can have an emphasis on motor planning or pragmatic communication, but all have a good collection of core and specialized words, and room for personalized vocabulary as well.
cause_effect_1: 对于AAC来说是全新的沟通者，有时从不使用沟通板开始是有好处的，只是为了帮助他们了解他们可以按一下按钮，事情就会发生。这些因果关系板可以帮助培训传播者如何以一种有趣的方式使用其访问方法。 [[ For communicators that are brand-new to AAC, sometimes it's beneficial to start with a non-communication board, just to help them learn that they can hit buttons and things will happen. These cause-and-effect boards can help train communicators how to use their access method in a fun way.
simple_starts_1: 对于一些使用少量简单按钮开始的沟通者，可以帮助他们使用AAC感到舒适。从简单的电路板设置过渡到更坚固或更长期的操作可能会比较棘手，但是每个沟通者都是不同的。 [[ For some communicators starting with a small set of simple buttons can help them get comfortable using AAC. It can be trickier to move from a simple board set to something more robust or long-term, but each communicator is different.
functional_1: 有时，强调更多功能性的交流对于交流者可能很有价值。开始使用AAC时，根据通信者的发展水平，功能板可能会更直观。 [[ Sometimes an emphasis on more functional communication can be of value for communicators. Depending on a communicator's developmental level when starting to use AAC, functional boards can be more intuitive.
phrases_1: 对于会说话的沟通者来说，录制自己的声音进行回放可能在压力很大的情况下或在ALS等退化条件下很有用。基于短语的板对于这些沟通者可能是有用的模板，并且可以与%app_name%的内置记录工具很好地配合，从而轻松为沟通者创建消息库。 [[ For communicators that can speak, recording their own voice for playback can be helpful in stressful situations, or for degenerative conditions like ALS. Phrase-based boards can be a useful template for these communicators, and work well with %app_name%'s built-in recording tools to easily create message banks for the communicator.
keyboards_1: %app_name%支持包含单词预测功能的自定义键盘，因此可以熟练拼写的通信者可能会受益于基于键盘的板集。一些键盘带有快速短语或常用词，以帮助加快通信速度。 [[ %app_name% supports custom keyboards that include word prediction, so communicators that can spell proficiently may benefit from keyboard-based board sets. a_little_about_aac: 首先，关于AAC的一些知识 [[ First, A Little About AAC
aac_intro_1: 感谢您注册%app_name%！我们很高兴您在这里，希望％app_name％有所作为。在深入了解％app_name％基础知识之前，我们想先谈谈AAC。 [[ Thanks for signing up for %app_name%! We're excited you're here and hope %app_name% makes a difference. Before we get into some %app_name% basics, we wanted to talk a little about AAC.
aac_intro_2: AAC（增补性和替代性交流）是一种工具，可以帮助发展交流者。 %app_name%是AAC的一种，您可以选择代表单词或字母的按钮，而设备会说出用户选择的内容。 [[ AAC (Augmentative and Alternative Communication) is a tool to help developing communicators be heard. %app_name% is a type of AAC where you select buttons that represent words or letters and the device speaks whatever the user selects.
aac_intro_22: AAC可以给那些难以独自讲话的人带来巨大的改变。理想情况下，用户可以从词典中的任何单词中进行选择，但是如果不能选择拼写，我们需要仔细选择正确的单词和短语，以最好地帮助每个人有效地进行交流。 [[ AAC can make a huge difference for people who have a hard time speaking on their own. Ideally users could pick from any word in the dictionary, but if spelling isn't an option, we need to carefully choose the right words and phrases to best help each individual communicate effectively.
aac_intro_3: 在%app_name%中，我们将单词和短语放在按“面板”集合组织的按钮上。针对许多不同的用户和需求，有不同的板组。 [[ In %app_name% we put words and phrases on buttons that are organized as a collection of "boards". There are different board sets for many different users and needs.
choosing_vocabulary: 选择正确的词汇 [[ Choosing the Right Vocabulary
aac_core_words: AAC核心词汇 [[ AAC Core Words
core_words_1: 用正确的词开始用户很重要-而且很辛苦！您如何确定某人应该动用哪些词？ [[ Starting a user with the right words is important -- and hard! How do you decide which words someone should have at their fingertips?
core_words_2: 许多人首先考虑基于需求的交流（“我需要去洗手间”，“我很伤心”，“我饿了”），这些都是可以表达的重要内容。但是，尝试包含可以以多种方式使用的常用单词也非常有价值。我们称这些类型的单词为“核心”单词。 [[ Many people think first about needs-based communication ("I need to go to the bathroom", "I am hurting", "I am hungry"), and these are important things to be able to express. However, it's also very valuable to try to include common words that can be used in more than one way. We call these types of words "core" words.
core_words_3: 核心词是诸如“ you”，“ I”，“ like”，“ not”，“ go”，“ in”等之类的词。它们可能似乎并不立即有用，但是随着时间的流逝，接触核心的用户单词可以表达许多不同的想法（“我喜欢”，“不想要”，“得到它”，“什么时候可以去那里”），并且可以更有效地加深他们的词汇量。 [[ Core words are words like "you", "I", "like", "not", "go", "in", etc. They may not seem as useful right away, but over time a user who is exposed to core words can express many different ideas ("I like it", "not want", "you get it", "when can we go there") and more effectively deepen their vocabulary.
core_words_4: 每个用户都是不同的，但是核心和专门的单词和短语的组合通常可以帮助沟通者逐渐增加其表达，而不会仅仅因为表达需求和欲望而陷入困境。 [[ Every user is different, but a combination of core and specialized words and phrases can often help a communicator grow their expression gradually, instead of being stuck only expressing needs and wants.
selecting_a_home_board: 选择主板 [[ Selecting a Home Board
home_board_1: %app_name%具有许多不同的主板，您可以立即开始使用它们，也可以在复制时进行个性化设置。有些主板有一些大按钮，有些则有许多小按钮。 [[ %app_name% has a number of different home boards that you can start using right away, or copy and personalize as you go. Some boards have a few large buttons, and some have many small buttons.
home_board_2: 更多的按钮意味着更多的表达方式，但是一些用户在他们可以可靠按下的按钮上受到限制（请记住，现在您始终可以隐藏按钮，稍后再添加，因此看起来“太忙”的面板可能实际上是随着时间的推移它们可以成长为某种东西） [[ More buttons means more options for expression, but some users are limited in how small a button they can reliably hit (keep in mind you can always hide buttons for now that you want to add later, so a board that looks "too busy" may actually be something they can grow into over time).
speak_mode_2: 当您处于朗读模式时，您可以点击按钮进行朗读，然后将其添加到顶部的发声框中。如果您点击发声框，它将说出那里的所有按钮。退格键和清除按钮可以帮助保持句子窗口的清洁。 [[ When you're in Speak Mode you can hit buttons to have them spoken, and added to the vocalization box at the top. If you hit the vocalization box it'll speak all the buttons that are located there. The backspace and clear buttons can help keep the sentence window clean.
app_speak_mode_folders: %app_name%语音模式文件夹 [[ %app_name% Speak Mode Folders
speak_mode_22: 在按钮上带有小文件夹图标的按钮是链接的按钮，这意味着如果选择它们，将带您进入另一个板。这样一来，您可以拥有多个级别，并且单词和短语比单个屏幕上显示的更多。您总是可以通过单击“主页”按钮回到第一板。 [[ Buttons that have a little folder icon on them are linked buttons, which means that if you select them it will take you to another board. This lets you have multiple levels, with more words and phrases than could fit on a single screen. You can always get back to the first board by hitting the home button.
app_exiting_speak_mode: %app_name%退出朗读模式 [[ %app_name% Exiting Speak Mode
speak_mode_3: 您可以通过点击右上角的用户菜单退出语音模式。如果您担心用户自己意外退出语音模式，则可以在用户首选项中设置PIN。 [[ You can exit out of Speak Mode by hitting the user menu in the top right corner. If you're worried about a user accidentally exiting Speak Mode on their own, you can set up a PIN in the user's preferences.
intro_modeling_3: 在%app_name%中，沟通者周围的支持团队称为“主管”。主管是为通讯员建模并与其一起工作的用户。他们具有自己的登录名，并且可能是老师或理疗师，父母，照料者等。 [[ In %app_name%, the support team around the communicator are called "supervisors". Supervisors are users that are modeling for and working with a communicator. They have their own login, and might be a teacher or a therapist, a parent, a caregiver, etc.
intro_modeling_4: 主管将添加到他们的沟通者帐户中，并且可以在自己的设备上看到沟通者的面板，因此他们可以适应用户的词汇表以更好地建模，并且可以在拥有编辑权限的情况下添加新的按钮和短语。 [[ Supervisors are added to their communicator's account, and can see a communicator's boards on their own devices, so they can get comfortable with a user's vocabulary for better modeling, and can add new buttons and phrases if they have editing permission.
logging_and_report: 记录和报告 [[ Logging and Reports
reports_1: 主管还可以查看用户的通信历史记录。出于隐私原因，默认情况下禁用日志和报告，但是如果启用它们，则用户的主管可以查看其通信随时间的进展情况。 [[ Supervisors can also review a user's communication history. For privacy reasons logs and reports are disabled by default, but if you enable them then the user's supervisors can see how their communication is progressing over time.
reports_2: 除了查看使用历史记录之外，主管还可以访问每个通信会话的详细报告，并可以与用户团队进行记录并共享注释，因此每个人都知道当前的策略是什么以及什么方法行之有效。 [[ In addition to reviewing usage history, supervisors can access detailed reports on each communication session, and can make and share notes with the user's team, so everyone knows what the current strategy is and what is or isn't working well.

modeling_intro_1: 学习使用AAC词汇非常类似于学习新语言。当您周围的人也使用它时，它要容易得多！您可以通过建模来提供帮助，该示例显示了如何使用它的示例（“您可以这样说”，然后您自己按一下按钮）。有时候，在交流者效仿您的示例之前，需要进行大量建模，因此请耐心等待！ [[ Learning to use an AAC vocabulary is a lot like learning a new language. It's much easier when the people around you use it too! You can help by modeling, which is showing examples of how to us it ("here's how you could say this" and then hit the buttons yourself). Sometimes it takes a lot of modeling before a communicator follows your example, so try to be patient!
modeling_intro_2: 进行建模时，您需要确保处于建模模式，因此%app_name%可以告诉您语音与沟通者之间的区别。您可以在仪表板上为通信器“建模”，也可以点按“清除”按钮三次以暂时进入建模模式。试试看，亲自看看！ [[ When modeling you'll want to make sure you're in modeling mode, so %app_name% can tell the difference between your speech and the communicator's. You can "model for" a communicator in your dashboard, or you can triple-tap the clear button to temporarily go into modeling mode. Give it a try and see for yourself!

compatibility_intro: %app_name%致力于与其他公司和组织合作，为传播者提供最佳体验。这是我们提供的一些合作伙伴和兼容资源。 [[ %app_name% is committed to working with other companies and organizations to provide communicators with the best possible experience. Here are some of the partners and compatible resources we have available.
community_partners_explainer: 社区合作伙伴是技术和支持合作伙伴，它们提供辅助技术资源和工具，也可以使某些沟通者及其支持团队更有效地使用TR1A。 [[ Community partners are technical and support partners that provide assistive technology resources and tools that can also make %app_name% usage more effective for some communicators and their support teams.

ablenet_explainer: AbleNet与保险公司合作，获得预安装%app_name%资助的QuickTalker FreeStyle专用平板电脑。 [[ AbleNet works with insurance to get their QuickTalker FreeStyle dedicated tablet funded with %app_name% pre-installed.
acapela_explainer: Acapela为语音生成提供优质的合成语音。 Acapela在%app_name%支持iOS，Android和Windows。 [[ Acapela provides premium synthesized voices for speech generation. Acapela voices in %app_name% for iOS, Android and Windows.
switch_explainer: %app_name%的内置开关激活的扫描功能可以使用一个或两个开关动作。大多数（如果不是全部）蓝牙开关都应该通过键盘仿真与％app_name％一起使用，并且在Windows上，也可以根据用户的喜好配置其他键盘样式的开关。 [[ %app_name%'s built-in switch-activated scanning will work with one or two switch actions. Most if not all bluetooth switches should work with %app_name% via keyboard emulation, and on Windows other keyboard-style switches can also be configured in a user's preferences.
blue2_explainer: Blue2开关可与移动设备和Windows设备配合使用，并提供一键和两键开关控制 [[ The Blue2 switch worked with mobile and Windows devices and provides one and two-button switch control
eye_trackers_explainer: 在Windows设备上，您可以下载并安装%app_name%应用，以将％app_name％与硬件眼动仪配合使用。目前，某些眼动仪（EyeX和EyeTribe）具有本机集成，而其他眼动仪（Tobii，myGaze，eyetech等）在光标模式下可以很好地运行。可以根据用户的喜好配置诸如停留时间和激活距离之类的设置。 [[ On Windows devices, you can download and install the %app_name% app to use %app_name% with hardware eye trackers. Some eye trackers (EyeX and EyeTribe) currently have native integrations, while others (Tobii, myGaze, eyetech, etc.) work very well running in cursor mode. Settings like dwell time and activation distance can be configured in a user's preferences.
head_pointers_and_mice: 头指针和鼠标 [[ Head Pointers and Mice
head_mouse_explainer: Windows上的鼠标光标可以由许多不同类型的界面控制，包括一些标题指针和鼠标头工具。可以使用%app_name%的内置驻留跟踪来配置这些应用和设备，该跟踪可在Windows％app_name％应用中获得。 [[ The mouse cursor on Windows can be controlled by many different kinds of interface, including some header pointers and head mouse tools. These apps and devices can be configured using %app_name%'s built-in dwell tracking, available in the Windows %app_name% app.
camera_mouse_explainer: Camera Mouse是一个免费的头部跟踪Windows应用程序，它使用计算机的摄像头来控制鼠标光标。 [[ Camera Mouse is a free head-tracking Windows app that uses the computer's camera to control the mouse cursor.
bluetooth_speakers_explainer: 有些设备的扬声器声音不够大，或者扬声器指向的方向错误，因此无法帮助沟通者有效地讲话。蓝牙扬声器可以与%app_name%一起使用，以促进通信，甚至可以使使用％app_name％更加有趣。 [[ Some devices don't have loud enough speakers, or have speakers that point the wrong direction so they don't help a communicator speak effectively. Bluetooth speakers can be used with %app_name% to facilitate communication, and even to make using %app_name% just a little more fun.
clipster_explainer: ION Clipster是一款夹式蓝牙扬声器，可以连接到设备并提供更大的音量，并从通信器中直接输出声音。 [[ ION Clipster is a clip-on bluetooth speaker that can connect to devices and provide additional volume and direct sound out in from of the communicator.
bluebee_explainer: 蓝蜂好朋友是可爱的毛绒动物，带有内置的蓝牙扬声器，说话时嘴巴会移动。它们可以成为开发交流者的绝佳加强工具。 [[ Bluebee Pals are cute stuffed animals with a built-in bluetooth speaker whose mouths move as they speak. They can be a great reinforcement tool for developing communicators.
keyguard_explainer: 对于某些用户而言，很难将手指放在正确的按钮上。键盘锁可以帮助他们导航到正确的位置，一些公司可以为几乎任何%app_name%主板配置创建自定义键盘锁。 [[ For some users it can be hard to get their fingers down on the right buttons. Keyguards can help them navigate to the right place, and some companies can create custom keyguards for just about any %app_name% board configuration.
lasered_pics_explainer: Lasered Pics可以为许多不同的平板电脑和设备创建自定义键盘锁。通过从设备向他们发送屏幕截图，他们可以支持许多%app_name%配置。 [[ Lasered Pics can create custom keyguards for many different tablets and devices. By sending them a screenshot from the device they can support many %app_name% configurations.
frs_keyguards_explainer: 福布斯AAC可以为与其ProSlate专用平板电脑配合使用的%app_name%不同配置创建自定义键盘锁。 [[ Forbes AAC can create custom keyguards for different %app_name% configurations that work with their ProSlate dedicated tablets.

profiles_explainer: 通信配置文件是评估工具，可用于评估或监控用户的通信发展。配置文件可以针对沟通者或与他们一起工作的人，并且可以多次运行。他们可以帮助确定用户的适当目标，并可以帮助团队协调有效的支持策略。 [[ Communication Profiles are evaluation tools that can be used to assess or monitor a user's communication development. Profiles can target communicators or the people who work with them, and can be run multiple times. They can help with deciding on appropriate goals for a user and can help teams coordinate on effective strategies for support.

privacy_intro: LingoLinq LLC（以下简称“LingoLinq”、“我们”或“我们的”）非常重视您的隐私。本隐私政策适用于我们的网站 (www.lingolinq.com) 以及 LingoLinq 的产品、软件和应用程序（统称为“产品”）。 [[ LingoLinq LLC ("LingoLinq," "we," "us," or "our") is deeply committed to your privacy. This Privacy Policy applies to our website (www.lingolinq.com) and LingoLinq's products, software, and applications (collectively, the "Product").
privacy_compliance: 由于 LingoLinq 在全球教育和医疗领域得到应用，我们采取了严格的数据保护措施，以符合当地、联邦和国际法规，包括 COPPA、FERPA、HIPAA、GDPR（欧洲）和 CCPA（加利福尼亚州）。 [[ Because LingoLinq is utilized globally in educational and medical settings, we employ stringent data protection practices designed to comply with local, federal, and international regulations, including COPPA, FERPA, HIPAA, GDPR (Europe), and CCPA (California).
privacy_philosophy: 我们的核心隐私理念很简单：除非您开启了需要保留对话记录的功能，否则我们不会保存您的对话记录。我们收集的任何用于改进产品的使用数据都经过严格匿名化处理，并且需要您明确同意。例外情况列于下方的“隐私保障”部分，您可以随时关闭这些例外情况。 [[ Our core privacy philosophy is simple: we do not keep transcripts of your conversations unless you switch on a feature that needs them, and any usage data we collect to improve our Product is strictly anonymized and requires your explicit opt-in. The exceptions are listed under the "Private Thoughts" Guarantee below, and each one can be switched off.
privacy_agreement: 使用本产品即表示您同意按照本政策所述的方式收集和使用您的信息。 [[ By using the Product, you agree to the collection and use of your information as described in this policy.
privacy_guarantee_heading: 1. LingoLinq 隐私保障 [[ 1. The LingoLinq Privacy Guarantee
privacy_guarantee_thoughts_heading: “私密想法”保障： [[ The "Private Thoughts" Guarantee:
privacy_guarantee_thoughts: LingoLinq 默认不保存交流者的对话记录。但有两个例外，我们宁愿明确说明，而不是隐瞒。首先是使用日志记录：此功能默认关闭，除非您手动开启。开启此功能需要单独的确认步骤。开启后，我们会加密存储每次发言的文本和每次按键的标签，并据此生成报告和统计数据。其次是 AI 词语预测：开启此功能后，我们会记录每次实际到达 AI 供应商的预测请求。该记录包含最多 200 个字符的句子内容，我们会先过滤掉可识别的识别信息。记录仅用于显示发送的内容和时间，我们自身缓存中响应的请求不会被记录。您可以在偏好设置中关闭这些功能。除此之外，您的想法和文字完全属于您。 [[ By default LingoLinq does not keep transcripts of a communicator's conversations. There are two exceptions, which we would rather state plainly than bury. First, usage logging: this is off unless you turn it on, and turning it on takes a separate confirmation step, but while it is on we store the text of each utterance and the label of each button pressed, encrypted, and we produce reports and statistics from them. Second, AI word prediction: while it is on, each prediction request that actually reaches the AI vendor is recorded, and that record includes up to 200 characters of the sentence being composed, with identifying details we can detect filtered out first; it is kept to show what was sent and when, and requests we answer from our own cache are not recorded. Each of these can be switched off in your preferences. Apart from them, your thoughts and words are yours alone.
privacy_guarantee_separation_heading: 严格隔离用户： [[ Strict Separation of Users:
privacy_guarantee_separation: 我们在法律和技术层面上将“账户管理员”（例如家长、治疗师或学区）的数据与“沟通者”（AAC 用户）的数据分开。营销、计费数据和网站 Cookie 仅适用于账户管理员。沟通者的界面不包含任何追踪像素、广告和营销信息。 [[ We legally and technically separate the data of the "Account Administrator" (e.g., the parent, therapist, or school district) from the "Communicator" (the AAC user). Marketing, billing data, and website cookies apply only to the Account Administrator. The Communicator's interface is free of tracking pixels, advertising, and marketing.

privacy_collect_intro: 我们仅收集安全运行 LingoLinq 所需的最低限度个人信息： [[ We collect the minimum personal information needed to operate LingoLinq securely:

pp_intro_1: LingoLinq 是一款功能强大、灵活的沟通应用和系统，它能够帮助沟通者及其团队制定个性化的语言学习策略，并实现高效沟通。由于 LingoLinq 被应用于医疗和教育领域，且用户年龄跨度较大，因此我们高度重视州和联邦法规，例如 FERPA、HIPAA 和 COPPA 等，并积极追踪与这些法规相关的政策。遵守隐私和安全法规需要 LingoLinq 与使用我们软件的机构通力合作。为此，我们制定了这套声明和最佳实践，以防止个人信息泄露给任何不应访问的人员。 [[ LingoLinq is a powerful, flexible communication app and system that enables communicators and the teams around them to develop a personalized language learning strategy and to communicate effectively. Because LingoLinq is used in medical and educational settings for different ages of user, we are sensitive to state and federal regulations like FERPA, HIPAA, COPPA, etc. and work hard to track policies related to those regulations. Compliance with privacy and security regulations requires collaboration between LingoLinq and the institutions that use our software. As such, we have compiled this set of assertions and best practices to prevent exposing personal information to anyone who shouldn't have access to it.
pp_intro_2: LingoLinq 使用云技术备份、同步和报告沟通者的词汇量和活动。我们这样做是为了方便用户（提供备份和多设备支持），帮助用户了解沟通者的进步，促进支持团队之间的协作，增强组织的责任感，并掌握网站的总体趋势。由于个人沟通信息可能涉及敏感内容，我们非常重视用户隐私。以下是我们的一些保护策略和最佳实践，您可以遵循这些策略和实践，以确保沟通者的隐私和权利得到尊重。提供这些信息旨在帮助组织进行决策和培训，并且可能会随时间而变化。 [[ LingoLinq uses the cloud to back up, synchronize, and report on a communicator's vocabulary and activities. We do this to provide convenience for users (backup and multi-device support), insights on communicator progress, collaboration across support teams, accountability for organizations, and general trends across the site. Because of the potentially sensitive nature of the information related to an individual's communication, we take user privacy very seriously. Below are some of our protection strategies, and best practices that you can follow to ensure the privacy and rights of the communicator are respected. The information is provided to help organizations in their decision-making and training processes, and may change over time.
pp_personal_pre: LingoLinq 默认会尽可能少地收集用户的个人信息。注册时，我们会要求用户提供用户名和电子邮件地址，并记录初始 IP 地址以进行位置追踪。用户提供的任何其他信息均为可选，且需用户选择是否启用。LingoLinq 的某些功能如果启用，将会导致更高级别的追踪和信息存储。例如，日志记录会在用户使用系统时记录额外数据，而个性化版块则会根据用户输入的信息存储额外的图像和数据字段。 [[ By default LingoLinq tries to collect as little personal information as possible about our users. At registration we ask for a username and email address, and we record the initial IP address for location tracking purposes. Any additional information provided by the user is optional and opt-in. Some features of LingoLinq, if enabled, will result in additional levels of tracking and information storage. For example, logging records additional data as the user uses the system, and the personalization of boards results in the storage of additional images and data fields based on the user-entered information.
pp_personal_bold: 我们鼓励治疗和教育团队共同探讨哪些信息适合添加到每个用户的信息中。 [[ We encourage therapy and educational teams to discuss together what information is appropriate to be added for an individual user

Most pages within LingoLinq can potentially contain private information, so rather than use confidential information warnings on every page,

pp_user_data_2_pre: 在系统中，用户可以指定他们的帐户是“公开的”，在这种情况下，用户输入的基本信息（如摘要、公共论坛等）将对所有 LingoLinq 用户可见，但这是一种选择加入的行为。 [[ Within the system users can specify that their account is "public", in which case basic user-entered information like summary, public boards, etc. will be available to any LingoLinq users, but this is an opt-in behavior.
pp_user_data_2_bold: 我们不鼓励将通讯账号设置为公开账号。 [[ We discourage communicator accounts from being set to public.

faq_ai_boards_q: 我可以利用AI板生成功能创建哪些有趣且引人入胜的演讲板？ [[ What are some interesting and engaging speech boards I can create using AI board generation?
faq_ai_boards_p1: AI 看板生成功能可以将简短描述转化为可编辑的初始布局——您可以像编辑其他看板一样，对按钮、分组和路径进行精细调整。最吸引人的看板都与现实生活紧密相关：例如特定的日常安排、地点、人物或目标，以及沟通者当周实际想要使用的词汇。 [[ AI board generation turns a short description into a starter layout you can edit—buttons, groups, and paths you refine like any other board. The most engaging boards are tied to real life: a specific routine, place, person, or goal, with vocabulary the communicator will actually want to use that week.
faq_ai_boards_p2: 尝试引导学生描述情境，而不仅仅是词汇类别。不要只列出“食物词汇”，而是描述“在食堂点午餐”或“放学后选择零食”。将核心词汇（想要、帮助、更多、停止）与特定情境下的边缘词汇（过敏、辛辣、借记卡、队友）混合使用。这种平衡能让词汇板在对话中发挥作用，而不仅仅是一个静态的词汇表。 [[ Try prompting for situations, not just categories. Instead of only "food words," describe "ordering lunch in the cafeteria" or "choosing a snack after school." Mix core words (want, help, more, stop) with fringe words for that moment (allergy, spicy, debit card, teammate). That balance keeps boards useful in conversation, not just as a static word list.
faq_ai_boards_list_intro: 适用于课堂和诊所的良好理念： [[ Ideas that work well in classrooms and clinics:
faq_ai_boards_li_1: 日常生活：早晨例行活动、家务、作业、就寝——每一项都有一组可预测的短语。 [[ Daily living: morning routine, chores, homework, bedtime—each with a small set of predictable phrases.
faq_ai_boards_li_2: 社会参与：操场游戏、俱乐部会议、与家人视频通话、与邻居闲聊。 [[ Social participation: playground games, club meetings, video calls with family, small talk with neighbors.
faq_ai_boards_li_3: 社区服务：杂货店、餐馆、药店、图书馆——问题、选择和解决问题的脚本。 [[ Community access: grocery store, restaurant, pharmacy, library—scripts for questions, choices, and problem-solving.
faq_ai_boards_li_4: 学习内容：单元科学词汇、数学讨论（估算、比较、证明）、实地考察安全和参与。 [[ Learning: science vocabulary for a unit, math talk (estimate, compare, prove), field trip safety and participation.
faq_ai_boards_li_5: 游戏和爱好：喜爱的游戏规则和轮次、体育加油口号、艺术或音乐课程请求。 [[ Play and hobbies: rules and turns for favorite games, sports cheers, art or music lesson requests.
faq_ai_boards_li_6: 调节与健康：镇静选择、疼痛或舒适度等级、症状解释、过敏和药物用语。 [[ Regulation and health: calming choices, pain or comfort scale, explaining symptoms, allergy and medication phrases.
faq_ai_boards_p3: 生成后，进行彻底的编辑：用沟通者的语气重命名按钮，交换符号以便快速阅读，并链接回稳定的主界面或备用面板。先从本月一个重要的场景入手，然后在感觉舒适后进行复制和调整。 [[ After generation, edit ruthlessly: rename buttons in the communicator's voice, swap symbols so they read quickly, and link back to a stable home or backup board. Start with one situation that matters this month, then duplicate and adapt once it feels comfortable.
faq_aac_q: 什么是辅助沟通系统（AAC）？（家长和照护者简明指南） [[ What Is AAC? (A Simple Guide for Parents & Caregivers)
faq_aac_intro_p1: 如果您的孩子或您关心的人有语言障碍，您可能听说过辅助沟通系统（AAC）。一开始可能会觉得难以理解，但AAC的本质是帮助人们以最适合他们的方式进行沟通。 [[ If your child—or someone you care for—has difficulty speaking, you may have heard the term AAC. It can feel overwhelming at first, but AAC is simply about helping people communicate in the way that works best for them.
faq_aac_intro_p2: 本指南将带您了解 AAC 的含义、适用人群、不同类型以及 LingoLinq 等工具如何融入其中。 [[ This guide will walk you through what AAC means, who it’s for, the different types available, and how tools like LingoLinq fit into the picture.
faq_aac_sub_what_stand: AAC是什么的缩写？ [[ What Does AAC Stand For?
faq_aac_stand_for_line: AAC 代表辅助和替代沟通。 [[ AAC stands for Augmentative and Alternative Communication.
faq_aac_def_augmentative_line: 增强型 = 在言语中添加 [[ Augmentative = adding to speech
faq_aac_def_alternative_line: 替代方案 = 替换演讲 [[ Alternative = replacing speech
faq_aac_simple_terms_lead: 简单来说： [[ In simple terms:
faq_aac_simple_body: AAC（辅助沟通系统）包括任何能够帮助说话困难或无法说话的人表达自己的沟通方式。 [[ AAC includes any method of communication that helps someone express themselves if speaking is difficult or not possible.
faq_aac_not_just: AAC 不仅适用于“不会说话”的人，也适用于任何需要帮助以更有效地沟通的人。 [[ AAC is not just for people who “can’t talk”—it’s for anyone who needs support communicating more effectively.
faq_aac_sub_who: AAC适用于哪些人群？ [[ Who Is AAC For?
faq_aac_who_intro: 辅助沟通系统（AAC）适用于所有年龄段的人群，从幼儿到成人。它可以为以下人群提供支持： [[ AAC is used by people of all ages, from young children to adults. It can support individuals with:
faq_aac_who_li_apraxia: 言语失用症 [[ Apraxia of speech
faq_aac_who_li_stroke: 中风或脑损伤 [[ Stroke or brain injury
faq_aac_who_li_als: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症或其他退行性疾病 [[ ALS or other degenerative conditions
faq_aac_who_li_temp: 暂时性失语（受伤、手术等） [[ Temporary speech loss (injury, surgery, etc.)
faq_aac_who_duration: 有些人短期使用辅助沟通设备，而有些人则终生依赖它。 [[ Some people use AAC short-term, while others rely on it throughout their lives.
faq_aac_important_label: 重要提示 [[ Important to know
faq_aac_important_label_colon: 重要须知： [[ Important to know:
faq_aac_important_body: 使用辅助沟通系统并不会阻碍一个人学习说话。在很多情况下，它实际上能够支持和促进语言发展。 [[ Using AAC does not stop someone from learning to speak. In many cases, it actually supports and improves speech development.
faq_aac_sub_types: 辅助沟通系统的类型 [[ Types of AAC
faq_aac_types_intro: AAC 可以分为两大类： [[ AAC can be broken into two main categories:
faq_aac_sub_low_tech: 1. 无技术/低技术辅助沟通系统 [[ 1. No-Tech / Low-Tech AAC
faq_aac_low_tech_desc: 这些不需要电子元件。 [[ These do not require electronics.
faq_aac_low_ex_gestures: 手势（指点、点头） [[ Gestures (pointing, nodding)
faq_aac_low_ex_books: 印刷通讯手册 [[ Printed communication books
faq_aac_low_pro_1: 简单可靠 [[ Simple and reliable
faq_aac_low_pro_2: 无需电池或安装 [[ No batteries or setup
faq_aac_low_con_2: 更难快速适应 [[ Harder to adapt quickly
faq_aac_sub_high_tech: 2. 高科技辅助空调 [[ 2. High-Tech AAC
faq_aac_high_tech_desc: 这些是帮助人们沟通的电子工具或应用程序。 [[ These are electronic tools or apps that help people communicate.
faq_aac_high_ex_sgd: 语音生成设备（SGD） [[ Speech-generating devices (SGDs)
faq_aac_high_ex_tablet: 基于平板电脑的 AAC 应用 [[ Tablet-based AAC apps
faq_aac_high_ex_gaze: 眼动追踪或基于注视的系统 [[ Eye-tracking or gaze-based systems
faq_aac_high_pro_1: 更大的词汇量 [[ Larger vocabulary
faq_aac_high_pro_2: 可以生成语音 [[ Can generate speech
faq_aac_high_con_1: 需要设置和学习 [[ Requires setup and learning
faq_aac_high_con_2: 可能更贵 [[ May be more expensive
faq_aac_sub_how_works: AAC的实际工作原理 [[ How AAC Actually Works
faq_aac_how_p1: 大多数 AAC 系统都是围绕通信板构建的——通信板由按钮、符号或文字组成。 [[ Most AAC systems are built around a communication board—a layout of buttons, symbols, or words.
faq_aac_user_might_label: 用户可能会： [[ A user might:
faq_aac_user_li_tap: 点击按钮 [[ Tap a button
faq_aac_user_li_picture: 选择一张图片 [[ Select a picture
faq_aac_user_li_gaze: 利用他们的眼睛（注视追踪） [[ Use their eyes (gaze tracking)
faq_aac_system_then_label: 当时的系统是： [[ The system then:
faq_aac_system_li_speak: 说出这个词或短语 [[ Speaks the word or phrase
faq_aac_system_li_sentence: 构建句子 [[ Builds a sentence
faq_aac_system_li_history: 存储通信历史记录 [[ Stores communication history
faq_aac_how_p2: 随着时间的推移，用户会逐渐了解单词的位置以及如何快速导航——就像在键盘上打字一样。 [[ Over time, users learn where words are located and how to navigate quickly—just like typing on a keyboard.
faq_aac_sub_lingolinq: LingoLinq 的定位 [[ Where LingoLinq Fits In
faq_aac_ll_intro: LingoLinq 是新一代 AAC 工具的一部分——它不仅关注沟通，更关注如何改善沟通方式。 [[ LingoLinq is part of the next generation of AAC tools—focused not just on communication, but on improving how communication happens.

faq_aac_ll_most_focus: 大多数辅助沟通工具都侧重于： [[ Most AAC tools focus on:

faq_aac_ll_inc_tap: 用户点击的位置 [[ Where users tap
faq_aac_ll_inc_time: 找到一个词需要多长时间 [[ How long it takes to find a word
faq_aac_ll_inc_reach: 难以到达的地区 [[ Areas that are hard to reach
faq_aac_ll_inc_patterns: 导航模式 [[ Patterns in navigation
faq_aac_ll_why_label: 为什么这很重要： [[ Why that matters:
faq_aac_ll_why_intro: 对于照护者、治疗师和教育工作者来说，这可以帮助解答以下问题： [[ For caregivers, therapists, and educators, this can help answer questions like:

faq_aac_ll_q_buttons: 哪些按钮容易让人困惑或难以找到？ [[ Which buttons are confusing or hard to find?
faq_aac_ll_q_struggling: 用户在哪方面遇到了困难？ [[ Where is the user struggling?
faq_aac_ll_insight_lead: 这种洞察力可以带来： [[ This kind of insight can lead to:
faq_aac_ll_out_design: 更好的电路板设计 [[ Better board design
faq_aac_ll_out_faster: 更快捷的沟通 [[ Faster communication
faq_aac_ll_out_independence: 用户拥有更大的自主权 [[ More independence for the user
faq_aac_bigger_p1: AAC 不仅仅是工具——它关乎赋予人们表达的权利。 [[ AAC is not just about tools—it’s about giving people a voice.
faq_aac_bigger_can_label: 合适的AAC系统可以： [[ The right AAC system can:
faq_aac_bigger_li_social: 改善社交联系 [[ Improve social connection
faq_aac_bigger_li_learning: 支持学习和发展 [[ Support learning and development
faq_aac_future_intro: 随着技术的发展，辅助沟通系统（AAC）正在演变为： [[ And as technology evolves, AAC is becoming:
faq_aac_sub_final: 最后想说的话 [[ Final Thoughts
faq_aac_final_intro: 如果你刚刚开始使用辅助沟通设备（AAC），请记住： [[ If you’re just starting your AAC journey, remember:
faq_aac_final_li_1: 没有“一刀切”的解决方案 [[ There is no “one-size-fits-all” solution
faq_aac_final_li_2: 尝试不同的方法是可以的。 [[ It’s okay to try different approaches
faq_aac_final_li_3: 进步需要时间，但意义非凡。 [[ Progress takes time—but it’s meaningful
faq_aac_final_li_4: 目标不是完美，而是沟通。 [[ The goal isn’t perfection—it’s communication

faq_cta_body: 您可以通过支持页面报告问题、发送反馈或联系团队。 [[ Report a problem, send feedback, or reach the team from the support page.

privacy_special_coppa_v2: 13岁以下儿童只有在获得可验证的家长同意后方可使用LingoLinq。我们仅在LingoLinq用于学校课程且不包含任何人工智能功能、不进行用户画像分析、不投放广告的情况下，接受学校官员根据《家庭教育权利和隐私法案》(FERPA) 出具的授权，以代替直接的家长同意。13岁以下儿童使用LingoLinq的任何人工智能功能，包括人工智能辅助生成棋盘和人工智能单词预测，均需根据《美国联邦法规》第16篇第312部分获得可验证的家长同意，无论其是否在校就读。如果我们发现已在未获得必要同意的情况下收集了13岁以下儿童的个人信息，我们将立即删除这些信息。 [[ Children under 13 may only use LingoLinq with verifiable parental consent. We accept a FERPA school-official authorization in place of direct parental consent only for the limited, school-curriculum use of LingoLinq with no AI features, no profiling, and no advertising. Any use of LingoLinq's AI features by a child under 13, including AI-assisted board generation and AI word prediction, requires verifiable parental consent under 16 CFR Part 312, regardless of school enrollment. If we learn we have collected personal information from a child under 13 without the required consent, we will delete it promptly.
privacy_special_ai_consent_intro: 由于使用 LingoLinq 的词语预测功能会将部分信息发送给外部人工智能公司，因此，除了上述通用家长同意书之外，我们还需要您单独签署一份针对该功能的第二次人工智能数据共享同意书。目前，人工智能生成的评估摘要功能处于禁用状态，不会向任何人工智能公司发送任何信息；该功能会在我们自己的系统中生成草稿，启用实时人工智能评估摘要功能需要更新信息披露并获得新的同意书，之后才会发送任何内容。您无需同意此第二次同意书即可使用 LingoLinq 的其他功能。请参阅我们的[此处插入链接]。 [[ Because using LingoLinq's word prediction sends some information to an outside AI company, we ask for a separate, second AI data-sharing consent beyond the general parental consent described above, specific to that feature. AI-drafted evaluation summaries are currently inactive and send nothing to any AI company; that feature produces a draft on our own systems instead, and turning on live AI evaluation summaries would require an updated disclosure and a fresh consent before anything is sent. You do not have to agree to this second consent to use the rest of LingoLinq. See our
privacy_security_retention_intro: 我们仅在实现收集目的所需的时间内保留个人数据，并根据我们的数据保留计划，对不同类别的数据保留期限进行划分。 [[ We retain personal data only as long as necessary for the purpose it was collected, with category-specific windows that align with our Data Retention Schedule.
privacy_security_retention_active: 活跃帐户数据：保留至帐户生命周期结束，加上最多 2 年的连续不活动期，之后帐户将被软删除并排队等待清除。 [[ Active account data: retained for the life of the account, plus up to 2 years of continuous inactivity, after which the account is soft-deleted and queued for purge.
privacy_security_retention_inactive: 不活跃账户：12 个月未使用的账户将被标记为自动删除，但对于意外删除，将有 10 天的宽限期。 [[ Inactive accounts: accounts inactive for 12 months are flagged for automatic deletion, subject to a 10-day grace period for accidental deletions.
privacy_security_retention_ai_logs: AI 请求日志：审计记录（AiApiLog）保留 2 年；这些记录中的 IP 地址在 90 天后被删除。 [[ AI request logs: the audit record (AiApiLog) is retained for 2 years; IP addresses on those records are redacted at 90 days.
privacy_security_retention_ai_eu: 我们已确认账户位于欧盟境内，并已安排对其中的人工智能请求日志进行为期五年的清理，但目前尚无任何记录因年代久远而被清除。此前，我们曾以欧盟人工智能法第50条作为此次清理期限的依据。但这是错误的：第50条是一项透明度条款，并未规定记录保存期限。目前，我们正在与律师审查此次清理期限的正确依据和具体时长。 [[ AI request logs for accounts we have confirmed are in the European Union: a 5-year purge is scheduled and running, though no record is yet old enough for it to have removed anything. We previously gave EU AI Act Article 50 as the reason for this window. That was wrong: Article 50 is a transparency provision and sets no record-keeping period. The correct basis and the length of this window are under review with our lawyers.
privacy_security_retention_voice: 语音和音频录制（您录制的按钮声音）：在用户帐户存在期间保留，并在帐户删除时删除。 [[ Voice and audio recordings (button sounds you record): retained for the life of the user account and deleted when the account is deleted.
privacy_security_retention_dwell: 停留时间、眼动追踪和头部追踪时间数据（存储在通信日志中）：默认保留 3 年，可根据用户或组织配置为更短的窗口期。 [[ Dwell, eye-gaze, and head-tracking timing data (stored within communication logs): retained for 3 years by default, configurable to a shorter window per user or organization.
privacy_security_retention_tenant: 学校和学区租户数据：在客户合同结束后 90 天内删除，除非数据处理附录中规定了更短的期限。 [[ School and district tenant data: deleted within 90 days after the customer contract ends, unless a shorter window is specified in the data processing addendum.
privacy_security_retention_children: 儿童数据（13岁以下用户）：家长可随时控制；用户年满18岁或连续两年未使用账户后（以较早者为准）数据将自动删除。经核实的家长删除请求将在30天内处理完毕。 [[ Children's data (users under 13): parent-controllable at any time; automatically purged at age 18 or after 2 years of inactivity, whichever is sooner. privacy_security_retention_backups: 备份遵循 35 天滚动恢复窗口；如果记录被删除，我们的保留策略会在任何恢复操作后重新应用删除操作。完整的计划，包括每个类别的法律依据和删除机制，可向我们的数据隐私团队索取。 [[ Backups follow a 35-day rolling window for operational recovery; if a record is deleted, our retention jobs re-apply the deletion after any restore. coaching_model_title: 设备上的模型 [[ Model on the device
coaching_model_body: 说话时，用手指轻敲AAC系统上的目标词语——示范，而不是询问。这就是辅助语言刺激法，AAC建模策略的黄金标准。 [[ Tap target words on the AAC system while you speak — show, don't ask. This is Aided Language Stimulation, the gold-standard AAC modeling strategy.
coaching_wait_title: 至少等待 10 秒 [[ Wait at least 10 seconds
coaching_wait_body: 示范结束后，请静默暂停10秒以上。使用辅助沟通设备（AAC）的用户通常需要额外的时间来计划和执行他们的回应。 [[ After modeling, pause silently for 10+ seconds. AAC users often need extra processing time to plan and execute their response.
coaching_routines_title: 融入日常生活中 [[ Embed in daily routines
coaching_routines_body: 将目标融入到吃零食时间、过渡环节、游戏环节和准备环节——这些自然而然的时刻，正是该词在房间里最有用的时刻。 [[ Build the target into snack time, transitions, play, and getting ready — natural moments where the word is the most useful one in the room.
coaching_generalize_title: 适用于所有合作伙伴和地点 [[ Generalize across partners and places
coaching_generalize_body: 确保这项技能能在不同的沟通伙伴之间、不同的场合、不同的活动中展现出来——而不仅仅是在治疗中。 [[ Make sure the skill shows up with different communication partners, in different settings, across different activities — not just in therapy.
coaching_celebrate_title: 重视努力，而非完美。 [[ Reinforce effort, not perfection
coaching_celebrate_body: 认可每一次尝试。使用快速评估功能记录训练过程，以便长期观察进步，而不是仅仅关注某一时刻的表现。 [[ Recognize every attempt. Log sessions with Quick Assessment so growth is visible over time, not measured by a single moment.

beta_agreement_title: LingoLinq Beta 测试协议 [[ LingoLinq Beta Test Agreement
beta_agreement_subtitle: 面向测试用户群体的通俗易懂的条款。请在继续之前阅读。 [[ Plain-language terms for our beta community. Please read before you continue.
beta_agreement_lead: 欢迎加入团队！在开始共同测试 LingoLinq 之前，请先阅读这份简短的协议。继续操作即表示您同意以下条款： [[ Welcome to the team! Before we start testing LingoLinq together, please look over this short agreement. By continuing, you agree to these terms:
beta_agreement_open_source_title: 开源与共享 [[ Open source & sharing
beta_agreement_share_title: 分享你的旅程： [[ Share your journey:
beta_agreement_share_body: LingoLinq 是开源软件。我们鼓励您分享屏幕截图、视频和评论，以帮助提升用户热情。 [[ LingoLinq is open source. We encourage you to share screenshots, videos, and reviews to help build excitement.
beta_agreement_ideas_body: 您的建议和错误报告将有助于改进 LingoLinq，使每个人都能从中受益，而您无需承担任何额外义务。 [[ Suggestions and bug reports may be used to improve LingoLinq for everyone, without extra obligations to you.
beta_agreement_privacy_title: 隐私与数据安全 [[ Privacy & keeping data safe
beta_agreement_privacy_body: 为了以最佳方式打造您的语音体验，我们需要了解它在实际应用中的运作方式。我们的工程师可能会使用通信和后台数据（遥测数据）来修复漏洞并提升速度。我们会根据我们的隐私声明保护这些数据。 [[ To build your voice in the best way possible, we need to understand how it works in real-world situations. Our engineers may use communication and background data (telemetry) to fix bugs and improve speed. We protect this data in accordance with our Privacy Notice.
beta_agreement_logs_body: 所有用于故障排除的通信日志在工程师查看之前都会去除姓名和个人资料信息。 [[ Any communication logs reviewed for troubleshooting are stripped of names and personal profiles before engineers see them.
beta_agreement_parents_title: 家长和监护人： [[ Parents & guardians:
beta_agreement_parents_body: 如果您是 13 岁以下测试者的家长，请在注册时填写我们的可验证家长同意书。 [[ If you are a parent of a tester under 13, complete our Verifiable Parental Consent during registration.
beta_agreement_schools_body: 在教育机构中，应确保获得学区批准或家长同意，以符合 FERPA 规定。 [[ In educational settings, ensure proper district approval or parental consent for FERPA compliance.
beta_agreement_clinicians_title: 临床医生和语言治疗师： [[ Clinicians & SLPs:
beta_agreement_clinicians_body: 在签署业务伙伴协议 (BAA) 之前，请勿输入真实的患者个人健康信息 (PHI)。联系方式 [[ Do not input real patient PHI until a BAA is signed. Contact
beta_agreement_forgotten_title: 你有权被遗忘 [[ Your right to be forgotten
beta_agreement_forgotten_body: 删除您的帐户。我们会在 48 小时内永久删除您的个人身份信息 (PII)，并且仅保留无法与您关联的数据。 [[ to delete your account. We permanently delete your PII within 48 hours and only keep data that cannot be linked back to you.
beta_agreement_safety_title: 辅助沟通设备用户的重要安全提示 [[ Important safety note for AAC users
beta_agreement_safety_lead: 随时准备好你的主要声音： [[ Keep your main voice handy:
beta_agreement_safety_body: 这是预发布版本软件，可能存在漏洞或偶尔崩溃。测试期间，请您随身携带主要通讯设备作为备用。请勿在测试阶段将 LingoLinq 作为唯一的通讯方式。 [[ This is pre-release software — it may have bugs or occasionally crash. Please keep your primary communication device with you as a backup while we test. Do not rely on LingoLinq as your only way to talk during this beta phase.
beta_agreement_legal_title: 法律方面的内容 [[ The legal stuff
beta_agreement_legal_body: 您需自行承担使用此测试版本的风险。LingoLinq 按原样提供，不提供任何担保。本协议有效期至我们正式发布或 Beta 测试计划结束为止。 [[ You use this test version at your own risk. LingoLinq is provided as-is without warranties. This agreement stays in place until our official launch or until the beta program ends.

privacy_beta_notice_body: 本通知适用于 LingoLinq 测试版期间，并在正式发布时失效。测试版期间，LingoLinq 为预发布软件，按“原样”提供。请始终保持您的主要通讯方式可用，不要在此期间将 LingoLinq 作为唯一的通讯方式。如果您选择加入，授权人员可能会查看匿名化的诊断使用数据，以修复错误并改进可访问性；根据我们的“隐私想法保证”，我们不会查看通讯者生成的词语或句子。对于 13 岁以下的用户，在收集任何数据之前，必须获得可验证的家长同意（或，如果是学校使用，则需获得学校官员的授权）。如果您将 LingoLinq 用于真实的患者信息，您的机构应首先与我们签订业务伙伴协议 (BAA)；请联系我们签署该协议。您可以随时请求删除您的帐户，删除时间遵循下文第 7 节所述的保留期限。 [[ This notice applies while LingoLinq is in beta and expires at general launch. During the beta, LingoLinq is pre-release software provided "as is." Please keep your primary communication method available at all times, and do not rely on LingoLinq as your only means of communication during this period. If you opt in, authorized staff may review anonymized, diagnostic usage data to fix bugs and improve accessibility; consistent with our Private Thoughts Guarantee, we do not review the words or sentences a communicator generates. For users under 13, verifiable parental consent (or, for school use, school-official authorization) is required before any data is collected. If you use LingoLinq with real patient information, your organization should have a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) in place with us first; contact us to execute one. You can request deletion of your account at any time, and deletion timing follows the retention windows described in Section 7 below.

privacy_sharing_ai: 用于人工智能辅助的董事会建议、词语预测，以及（仅当言语治疗师单独提出要求时）人工智能撰写的评估摘要； [[ for AI-assisted board suggestions, word prediction, and, only when a speech-language pathologist takes a separate action to request it, AI-drafted evaluation summaries;
privacy_sharing_ai_vendors: 本通知中所述的AI功能，包括AI辅助的看板建议、词语预测和AI生成的评估摘要，均使用Anthropic公司托管在Amazon Bedrock上的Claude模型，该模型位于由LingoLinq控制的AWS账户内，并已签署商业伙伴协议（看板建议和词语预测使用Claude Haiku 4.5版本）。语音转录、语音合成和看板翻译由独立的Google服务处理；这些服务不受本段控制范围的约束，并受其自身设置的约束。当您使用这些功能时，所需文本将通过Amazon Bedrock发送到AWS，由Anthropic公司的Claude模型进行处理。在发送任何内容之前，我们会自动过滤掉我们能够检测到的常见识别信息，例如姓名、电子邮件地址、电话号码和账户标识符；此过滤并非完美无缺，我们将结果描述为已清理或匿名化的数据，而非正式的法律标准中移除所有识别信息。您可以在账户偏好设置中关闭您个人账户的 AI 功能；管理该账户的组织可以为所有其管理的账户关闭这些功能；对于 13 岁以下的儿童，这些功能将一直处于禁用状态，直到我们获得必要的家长同意。目前，AI 生成的评估摘要功能处于禁用状态：请求生成摘要时，系统会在我们自己的系统中生成草稿，不会将任何内容发送给任何 AI 供应商。如果我们启用此功能，它将使用相同的 Amazon Bedrock 路径和相同的过滤规则，并且我们会在发送任何评估数据之前更新此通知，以明确模型名称。在 Amazon Bedrock 上，模型提供商完全不会收到此信息，AWS 也声明不会使用这些信息来训练任何模型。AWS 可能会出于安全和防止滥用的目的在有限的时间内保留这些信息，因此我们目前不保证此路径不会保留任何数据。 [[ The AI features described in this notice, meaning AI-assisted board suggestions, word prediction, and AI-drafted evaluation summaries, use Anthropic's Claude models hosted on Amazon Bedrock, inside a LingoLinq-controlled AWS account under a signed Business Associate Agreement (Claude Haiku 4.5 for board suggestions and word prediction). Separate Google services handle speech transcription, speech synthesis, and board translation; those are not covered by the controls in this paragraph and are governed by their own settings. When you use one of these features, the text it needs is sent to AWS through Amazon Bedrock for processing by an Anthropic Claude model. Before anything is sent, we automatically filter out common identifying details we can detect, such as names, emails, phone numbers, and account identifiers; this filter is not perfect, and we describe the result as scrubbed or pseudonymized data, not the formal legal standard for removing all identifying information. You can turn AI features off for your own account in your preferences, an organization that manages the account can turn them off for everyone it manages, and for a child under 13 they stay blocked until we have the required parental consent. AI-drafted evaluation summaries are inactive today: asking for one produces a draft written on our own systems, and nothing is sent to any AI vendor. If we switch that on, it would use the same Amazon Bedrock path and the same filtering, and we would update this notice to name the model before any evaluation data is sent. On Amazon Bedrock the model provider does not receive this information at all, and AWS states it is not used to train any model. AWS may retain it for a limited period for safety and abuse prevention, so we do not currently claim a zero-data-retention guarantee for this path.
